_comment: Genesis overlay for the stablenet account-Extra bitmap cases (regression h-hardfork h-30/h-33/h-34). It adds three alloc accounts whose Extra bits seed AccountManager status at genesis-init (bit 62 = authorized, bit 63 = blacklisted) and seeds GovCouncil's authorized/blacklisted lists to match. Deep-merged into the built stablenet genesis by `chainbench setup --genesis-overlay`; declares the account-extra capability so the gated cases run.
